projectDescription: A lightweight, browser-based milestone timeline planner with risk tracking, team member management, and SVG/PNG export — no installation required.
keyFeatures: Create and manage multiple saved timelines in the browser
Add, edit, drag-to-reschedule, and delete milestones on an interactive SVG timeline
Track milestone statuses: Planned, In Progress, Completed, and Overdue
Attach risks to milestones with owner assignment, mitigation state, and per-risk update history
Shared team member list with initials, Gravatar email lookup, or uploaded avatar photos
Optional time specification mode for precise scheduling
Configurable timeline date range with optional current-date marker
Download timelines as SVG or PNG files
Auto-stacking label rows to prevent overlap on crowded timelines
Light gray weekend bands and Monday-aligned date axis ticks
Browser-local data persistence — no account or server required
publicApiSurface: Add Milestone (control panel button / list footer button / timeline axis click)
Edit Milestone (click title or marker in timeline / row edit icon / milestone dialog)
Drag Milestone Marker (reschedule by dragging on timeline axis)
Delete Milestone (hover delete icon on timeline or row)
Set Milestone Status (Planned / In Progress / Completed)
Add / Edit / Delete Risk on a Milestone
Add / Edit Team Member (name, email, avatar upload or Gravatar)
Set Current Date (date input or 'Now' button)
Set Timeline Date Range (start/end inputs or 'Auto')
